offline: You are offline. Your saved information is safe, but this step needs internet.
timeout: This is taking too long. Check your connection and try again.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
welcome_help: Sign in to save your field details and advice.
err_exists: This email is already registered. Please sign in.
err_invalid: Please check your details and try again.
a_help: Fill in what you know. Only the crop is required.
pest_note: Pest names are shown in English until verified local names are added.
c1_photo: The plant photo is used as preliminary evidence for recommendations; the original image is not saved.
c2_help: Used to estimate costs. You can leave this empty.
c3_help: Used for local help and the risk check.
f_reports: Pest cases seen or heard of nearby in the last 7 days
f_reports_help: This is your own count, not official data.
weather_note: Weather is fetched only when you allow location access. Exact coordinates are not saved.
err_area_max: Field size cannot be more than 10000 acres.
err_whole: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
save_all: Save field information and view recommendations
b_help: These use the information you saved.
p_help: Take or choose a clear photo of the affected plant.
p_tips: Use daylight. Show the affected leaf or plant clearly. No people or documents in the photo.
p_internet: Needs internet. The photo is sent to an online service.
p_err_type: Please choose a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
p_err_size: This photo is too large even after shrinking. Choose a smaller one.
p_err_not_configured: Photo analysis is not set up on this server yet. Please tell the app administrator.
p_err_failed: The photo could not be analyzed. Try again or choose another photo.
p_verify: A local expert must confirm this before any treatment.
p_english: The details below are in English.
bu_sample: Sample price for planning. Not a supplier quote.
r_help: Uses your crop, location, weather and available verified evidence. It will not invent an outbreak alert.
r_based: Based on {n} case(s) you reported in the last 7 days.
r_insufficient: Not enough information. Enter the number of nearby cases (0 or more) in Your location.
r_not_official: This is not an official alert.
pl_assume: Plan for {days} days starting {date}. These are generic steps, not specific to your crop.
co_help: The advisor will choose evidence-supported next steps for your crop. You do not need to select a treatment.
co_ok: No conflict found in the sample rules
co_unknown: Cannot confirm. Not in the sample rules.
co_note: Always read the product label and ask your KVK.
su_help: Find verified local agricultural support. The app will not invent supplier names or stock.
su_none: No verified supplier found. Ask your local KVK.
su_sample: Sample entry, not a real shop. No price or stock information.
n_empty: No saved advice yet. Ask a question to start.
ask_help: Get a recommendation from your crop, photo, weather, field size and budget. You do not need to choose a pest-control method.
ask_placeholder: For example: Leaves are being eaten. What should I do?
ask_btn: Make a recommendation for my field
ask_english: Recommendations are generated only when relevant evidence and the configured model are available. Confirm uncertain diagnoses with your local KVK.
ask_sample: No sample answer is shown; recommendations require verified evidence.
footer: Recommendations are generated only when relevant evidence and the configured model are available. Confirm uncertain diagnoses with your local KVK.
ask_internet: Needs internet to get advice from the server.
ask_mismatch: Recommendations are generated only when relevant evidence and the configured model are available. Confirm uncertain diagnoses with your local KVK.
weather_denied: Location was not shared. Enter your district or try again.
weather_unavailable: Current weather is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
p_err_unclear: This photo is too dark or unclear. Retake it in daylight, hold the camera steady, and show the affected area close-up.
